title: Kerusi Lebih Satu
genre: Malay ronggeng band (1930s-style violin-and-accordion dance song)
subject: Hanim counts the borrowed plastic chairs after a doa selamat kenduri, finds one extra marked in white paint with Zul's name, and keeps miscounting so he has to come and fetch it himself
caption: Malay ronggeng, brisk dance-hall sub-style with pantun-answer phrasing. Singing violin playing quick ornamented runs, button accordion pumping offbeat chords, rebana frame drum with loose jingles, small hanging gong on every fourth bar, upright bass walking. Dry vintage room sound, no reverb tail, live-band feel. Female alto lead, mid register, bright forward delivery with a light male response on the chorus tag. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 126 BPM, D major. Playful, flirty, brisk mood. No electric guitar, no drum machine, no autotune, no rap, no synth, no trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - violin, accordion, rebana]

[Verse 1]
Kenduri doa selamat dah habis
Hanim kira kerusi bawah khemah
Tiga kampung bagi pinjam kerusi biru
Nama tuan tulis cat putih kat kaki

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, sampai empat puluh
Eh, kenapa jadi empat puluh satu?

[Chorus]
Kerusi lebih satu, siapa punya?
Cat putih tulis Zul, Kampung Parit
Hanim kira lagi, sengaja salah
Biar dia datang ambil sendiri

[Verse 2]
Pak Ngah dah angkat periuk kawah
Budak-budak dah susun pinggan
Zul sampai naik motor pukul empat
Kopiah senget, peluh kat dahi

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, sampai empat puluh
Dia kata, eh, memang lebih satu

[Chorus]
Kerusi lebih satu, ambillah Zul
Tapi duduk dulu, minum air sirap
Hanim kira lagi, tak habis-habis
Biar kerusi tu tunggu kita

[Bridge - rebana and gong]
Orang dah balik, khemah dah longgar
Dua kerusi tinggal, dua orang duduk

[Outro - violin and accordion]
Satu, dua, tiga, kira lagi
Kerusi lebih satu, kita lebih dua
